summary: Verified bug fix: Settings ↔ Yeni Lead source dropdown sync (lead_sources) + registry additions. Backend pytest (7/7 passed) + Playwright E2E for all 3 states (A/B/C). Original list restored.

issues: Non-blocking a11y warning: DialogContent missing Description or aria-describedby (Radix warning). Same warning appears across multiple dialogs — cosmetic, not related to this bug.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py: /options/all exposes lead_sources, lead_statuses, sale_types but NOT meeting_types — Yeni Lead → Görüş modal 'Növ' select gets meeting_types from a separate fetch. Verified via UI test that meeting_types Settings sync works via /api/settings/lists/meeting_types. Consider adding it to /options/all for consistency.
server.py line 5227: _get_setting_list defaults list is hardcoded at call site AND in LIST_DEFAULTS registry — duplication. Suggest deriving from LIST_DEFAULTS[key] to avoid drift.
seed_data_creation: Temporary TEST_Google Ads added and removed from lead_sources; original 7 defaults restored at end. sale_types, lead_statuses, meeting_types briefly overridden with TEST_ values and restored.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Bug fix for Settings ↔ Yeni Lead lead_sources sync fully verified. Backend _get_setting_list now respects empty [] doc; GET /settings/lists/{key} seeds from LIST_DEFAULTS when doc absent. Registry MANAGEABLE_LISTS extended with lead_sources/sale_types/meeting_types. Playwright confirmed Yeni Lead dropdown reflects Settings changes for add/remove/clear scenarios (empty→only 'Baza' fallback from FE).
rca of the issue: Root cause was truthy-check on doc.get('values') in _get_setting_list — `[]` evaluated falsy so backend silently fell back to hardcoded defaults, desyncing Settings UI (which read the raw list) from /options/all (which fed Yeni Lead). Fix: check `doc is not None` first; only fallback when doc absent. Additionally LIST_DEFAULTS registry keeps first-run seed values consistent.
